events.speaker: Informa
events.text: That transformation drained a third of the department budget!

events.speaker: Informa
events.text: It's called F.E.E.T - Flight-to-Earth Environment Transformation.

events.speaker: Doug McGug
events.text: And those rockets under your ship? L.E.G.S - Ludicrous Engineered Groundwalking Shoes.

events.speaker: Informa
events.text: Anyway... small problem. Inf Corp has been sponsoring these enemy waves to 'stress-test' our new systems.

events.speaker: Informa
events.text: Meaning they literally paid hostile drones to attack us so they could watch the numbers go up.

events.speaker: Informa
events.text: So yeah. We should probably stop them before they write this off as a 'successful experiment'.
